payload.criterion: The stepper test passes 20 of 20 runs of the full app test file under -n 4, and a new test that toggles the pane scrollbar fails before the fix
payload.verify_command: for i in $(seq 20); do uv run -q --with textual --with pytest --with pytest-xdist python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -n 4 -p no:cacheprovider || break; done
